sense: the forming or shaping of something

terms.gloss: forming, shaping; the shape that results
terms.comment: Cicero’s word for the shaping of a thing and the shape it takes: of the body’s features, of the voice, of a sentence. Latin more often says it with a verb (fōrmāre, fingere, cōnstituere): while the state was being formed, dum cīvitās cōnstituitur.

terms.gloss: a shaping, a forming; a design
terms.comment: Post-Augustan: Vitruvius of the plan of a building, Seneca of the formation of character (mōrum fōrmātiō).

sources: Lewis & Short: conformatio · Lewis & Short: formatio
